The user wants to mark compilation errors from the bottom console with a red line in the left margin of the editor at the exact line of the error.

T1 looked for reading errors from the console text. It found rendering/event handling in the problems tab, not the parsing mechanism.
T2 looked for drawing the red line in the left margin. It found `line gutter marker`, `fold gutter marker`, `line diagnostic marker from map`, `line diagnostic marker`.
T3 looked for extracting compilation errors from the console text to create diagnostics. It found the mechanism: `find compiler location` invoked by `terminal row link` processing `terminal styled rows`. It delegates to parsers like `parse gcc style`, `parse msvc style`, etc.

The user's request is to connect these two: the extraction of errors from the console (T3) and the drawing of the red line in the editor margin (T2).
T3 found how errors are extracted from the console.
T2 found how the red line is drawn in the editor margin.
